players.product: compression molding systems for HBM/advanced packaging

quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (annual securities report): net sales JPY 54,365 million (+1.7%, a record high), operating income JPY 6,917 million (-22.1%), ordinary income JPY 6,947 million (-26.1%), profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 4,593 million (-43.4%). Management states the year started weakly under the impact of US tariff policy, but from the second half the recovery of general-purpose memory investment, centred on server applications, let the company steadily capture demand for its molding equipment, which has a strong adoption record in memory; profits fell on product-mix changes and one-time additional costs tied to first deliveries. Operating income bridge: higher sales +JPY 414 million; upfront costs of first-unit projects with heavy development content, a lower share of high-margin products and more low-margin projects -JPY 1,257 million; higher development costs in cost of sales -JPY 692 million; higher SG&A -JPY 428 million. On the market, management states data-center investment driven by generative AI stayed firm with demand for AI logic semiconductors and HBM leading the market, general-purpose DRAM investment also increased from the second half on tight supply and price recovery, while automotive and industrial applications saw prolonged inventory adjustment and restrained capex.
quarterly_data.figure: net sales JPY 54,365 million (+1.7%); operating income JPY 6,917 million (-22.1%)

quarterly_data.signal: Segments, fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (annual securities report): Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment net sales JPY 49,870,942 thousand (+1.9%) as sales to Taiwan and China rose on higher general-purpose memory investment and singulation equipment sales grew sharply; segment operating income JPY 6,518 million (-22.0%), hurt by a worse product mix in transfer molding equipment and one-time additional costs tied to first deliveries of compression molding equipment. Medical Device net sales JPY 2,487 million (+9.9%), operating income JPY 451 million (-0.3%). Laser Processing Equipment net sales JPY 2,007 million (-11.0%) on weak capex demand for its main laser trimmer products, operating loss JPY 53 million (prior year operating income JPY 73 million). Sales by region (all segments): China JPY 22,227,380 thousand, Other Asia JPY 15,340,045 thousand, Taiwan JPY 7,233,515 thousand, Japan JPY 6,913,058 thousand, Americas JPY 2,529,210 thousand, other JPY 122,014 thousand. R&D expenses JPY 816 million (Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment JPY 728 million, Laser Processing Equipment JPY 88 million).

quarterly_data.signal: Second Medium-Term Management Plan targets for the fiscal year ending March 2028 (annual securities report; table in units of JPY 100 million, FY ended March 2026 actual in brackets): net sales 710 (543.6), of which Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment 521 (403.9), Medical Device 28 (24.8), new businesses 133 (94.7), Laser Processing Equipment 28 (20.0); operating income 156 (69.1), operating margin 22.0% (12.7%); ordinary income 156 (69.4); profit attributable to owners of the parent 109 (45.9); ROE 13% or more (7.0%). Semiconductor equipment strategy: meet customer needs through process innovation, become the global cost leader through DX and AI, bring one-of-a-kind products to the world through a global development structure; new businesses: higher value-added products built on core competencies, a major tool brand, subscription and renewal businesses; laser: in-house oscillation units, subscription, and applying laser technology to semiconductor processes. The plan sits under the long-term TOWA Vision 2032 (announced March 2022), which aims to be the world's leading company creating customer value through packaging-process proposals.
quarterly_data.figure: FY ending March 2028 targets (JPY 100 million): net sales 710; operating income 156; operating margin 22.0%

quarterly_data.signal: Capex, fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (annual securities report): JPY 4,196,156 thousand group-wide, of which Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment JPY 3,974,739 thousand, mainly production-plant buildings and machine tools (including software of JPY 709,855 thousand); cash spent on property, plant and equipment to maintain and expand production capacity was JPY 3,274 million. The company states it had no material plans for new construction or retirement of facilities as of the fiscal year end. Main production sites include the Kyoto head-office plant, the Kyoto East plant and Kyushu plant (precision molds), TOWAM (head plant and one other plant) and TOWA Tool in Penang, Malaysia, plants in Suzhou and Nantong (Jiangsu), China, and the plants of TOWA Fine (Gyeonggi) and TOWA Korea (head plant and one other plant, South Chungcheong) in Korea.
